title: The Battle of Los Angeles
hook: Why did the sky over Los Angeles explode with fire?
headline: Mystery lights over wartime Los Angeles

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: On February 25, 1942, anti-aircraft guns fired at mysterious lights over Los Angeles.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: Witnesses reported a bright orange glow and a booming sound that lasted ten minutes.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: The Army later claimed a stray weather balloon set off the anti-aircraft barrage.

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: In 1994, declassified files showed no Japanese aircraft were detected, deepening the mystery.

end.line: What really lit up the night over Los Angeles?

description: Explore the 1942 Los Angeles anti-aircraft barrage and its lingering unanswered questions.
